title: Newark Rent Control Ordinance rent increase rules
requirement: A landlord may raise rent only as the Rent Control Board allows; a hardship increase requires substantial code compliance, may not be granted more than once in a 12-month period, and is apportioned by the rent roll. Violations draw a penalty up to $500.
key_value: no increase more than once per 12-month period
penalty: The Rent Control Board may impose a monetary penalty not exceeding $500 for a violation of any provision of this chapter, after notice and a hearing.
quoted_span: No increase pursuant to this section shall be authorized with respect to a rental unit more than once in any twelve-month period, nor shall the Board conduct a hearing with respect to an application for such a rent increase for a rental unit more than once within a twelve-month period.
